description: This file defines the internal class SiloInstanceRecord used for representing and managing silo instance data within the Orleans clustering membership service, including serialization/deserialization from DynamoDB attribute dictionaries, and utility methods for identity construction and string representation.

classes.name: SiloInstanceRecord
classes.description: Represents a record of a silo instance in the Orleans clustering system, with properties for various silo attributes, methods for initialization from DynamoDB attribute dictionary, and utility functions for identity and string representation.

methods.name: SiloInstanceRecord
methods.description: Default constructor for creating an empty SiloInstanceRecord.

methods.name: SiloInstanceRecord(Dictionary<string, AttributeValue> fields)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes a SiloInstanceRecord from a dictionary of DynamoDB attribute values.

methods.name: UnpackRowKey
methods.description: Static method to parse a row key string into a SiloAddress object.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the silo instance record.

methods.name: ConstructSiloIdentity
methods.description: Static method to construct a silo identity string from a SiloAddress.

methods.name: GetKeys
methods.description: Returns a dictionary of key attributes for DynamoDB.

methods.name: GetFields
methods.description: Returns a dictionary of all fields for DynamoDB, optionally including key attributes.
